  - Added `syncDarkModeAvailability()` — disables/unchecks "Include dark mode" whenever the theme isn't `rebrand` (canvas/canvasHighContrast don't support dark mode), replacing the old row-hiding-only logic at all three call sites (postMessage theme apply, theme button click, preset restore).

  - `updatePreview()`'s `previewScheme` now also requires `previewDarkOverride` before rendering the preview in dark mode.
